name: set_cleaning_mode
description: Set the cleaning mode the Dreame vacuum will use, for a whole-house clean or a room clean. This only changes settings, it does not start a clean. If CleanGenius (the vacuum's automatic mode, which ignores the manual mode) is on, this turns it off so that the chosen mode takes effect, and the result says so.

mode.description: The cleaning mode to set: sweep (vacuum only), mop (mop only), sweep_and_mop (both at once) or mop_after_sweep (vacuum the whole area first, then mop it).
